candidates.review_text: My family and I absolutely love this place.  The food is amazing and the service is wonderful.  We've been two times and both times everything was perfect.  The mushroom appetizer is to die for! The veal is so tender and delicious that you can cut it with a fork.  We have gotten the veal viola, veal carciofi, linguine pizzaioli (which has veal, capers and olives in a spicy red sauce), and the chicken rollatini.  The prices are reasonable and the portions are huge.  The veal/chicken dishes are served with vegetables, so a side of spaghetti costs extra, but it's so worth it! The side is huge and the red sauce is hands-down the freshest, most delicious sauce I've had since being in Italy.  The restaurant is BYOB and the outdoor area is picturesque with all of the overhead lights.  The desserts are reasonably priced and delicious, we especially loved the tiramisu and the cannoli cake.  Lastly, the staff is friendly, welcoming and attentive.

This place is pretty awesome. Xfinity Live made a great move by getting rid of the fancy shmancy restaurant that used to be there and putting this one in. It has more of a polished and professional vibe than the other 3 places at Xfinity, but still has a young, fun atmosphere.

The food was great. It's a nice change of pace to see unique menu offerings at a place full of sports bars if you're not in the mood for wings or a burger. They also have a nice selection of vegetarian options for people like my room mate who normally only has 1-2 options on the menu when we go out to eat. Do yourself a favor and get the cheese fundido with house-made chips!

I'm normally a beer drinker but I tried one of their signature cocktails (and tried sips of my friend's drinks) and they were all amazing. I'd go back just for one of those drinks!!

Last but not least, service was perfect. Staff was friendly, knowledgable, and attentive without being overbearing. Our waitress gave great recommendations and asked for feedback. All in all, it was a great experience!

My bf has been raving about this restaurant for a few weeks so we finally decided to go last night. The atmosphere is nice and cosy. I wasn't a fan of the music. I was expecting, idk, mexican music? They were playing rock/alternative but whatever.

I ordered a pineapple margarita that was just okay, not much tequila in it. They give complimentary chips and salsa which was REALLY good We shared beef empanadas as an appetizer. He LOVES them, I thought they were just okay but I can't quite put my finger on what was throwing them off for me. The quac that came with the empanadas was excellent, however and I ended up scarfing it down with the chips!. I got a chicken chimichanga as my entree and it was very good! My bf got the steak fajitas and he also LOVED it. I tried the steak and must say it was delicious and perfectly cooked.  

I wouldn't say the staff was "friendly" but they were attentive and efficient, which I actually prefer over someone friendly and incompetent. Overall it was a good experience and I'm sure I will be going back in the future.

Today was my first time here and it was amazing. The food was absolutely delicious and the staff was amazingly friendly. The staff was very attentive to our needs and checked up on us to make sure everything was good. I appreciated that they didn't hover like a lot of waitresses do at other restaurants. Food was already preparied and ready to go which didn't take long to surve us. Me and my family will definitely be going back.

The food was amazing, the service could've been a bit better for sure. Our waiter wasn't very attentive or friendly at the least. However, other staff in the restaurant were very helpful and friendly.

One of the best burgers I've ever had! Village Whiskey has high-quality meat, great preparation, and awesome sides -- it's my favorite burger place in downtown Philly. 

The aioli and fries are delicious, too. Last time I tried truffled cauliflower; I'm not usually a huge fan of picked foods, but it was fantastic! The cauliflowers and carrots were crispy, and the juice had a light but very tasty flavor. I would definitely order it again. 

The one catch: it is pretty expensive. Probably place you would go to for an especially fun or nice meal, but might not be able to afford each week. 

The decor is cozy and up-scale, with small round tables surrounded by tall couches to sit on. You can hang up your coat when you enter the door, and the hostess stands behind a large wooden whiskey barrel. It's a small restaurant, so it's better for dinner with a few friends or a date than large groups. The waiters are very friendly and attentive, and service is quick. All in all, a very pleasant dining experience!

Boy am I glad that I follow Philly foodies on instagram or it would have taken me longer to find this gem.  I would call this coffee shop a hole in the wall kinda place, but that wouldn't do it justice. Win Win is definitely a diamond in the rough (shout out to Aladdin reference) 

The outside looks a little rough, but the inside is darling. The atmosphere is relaxed, trendy, and cute. Definitely a cute date and a fun place to go for drinks and food with friends. 

I can't speak to the coffee, however their selection looks amazing. They have tons of tea options as well. More importantly, they incorporate some coffee into their alcoholic drinks...aka buzz worthy (; The mixed drinks all looked so good ! But I decided to go for a glass of wine which cost about $7.

The main attraction though...pizza gut. O.M.G. I would like to think I have a really good palette when it comes to tasting and judging Italian food since my family always made homemade Italian dishes, including homemade pizza. I am not exaggerating this is the best pizza I've ever had. First of all, it is thick, fluffy, and crispy all at once. The ingredients are so fresh. You can tell the chef takes time to carefully craft each one.  The tomato/pizza sauce was unlike anything I've ever had and was super light and tasty.  It just made me so happy. The pizza is cut into six slices and is easily shared among two people.  I ate two slices and my bf ate the other 4 (and barely finished the 4th because each slice is very filling).  The pizza was $20 for spinach, sauce, cheese, ricotta, and pecorino. At first I thought ooooh a little pricey. But it is BEYOND worth it. I can't wait to go back.

Also the staff is very welcoming and attentive!

It is a great place, and the staff is extremely patient despite the locals that were extremely rude while we were there.  They are "servers", not "servants", you know what I mean?  As an artist myself, I was a little ashamed of the self important jerks as they talked about how important they were loud enough that all could hear and all but knocked two patrons out of their seat to take up more room in the restaurant.  That being said, the food was great, my drink was fine, and the server was attentive despite the snaps in the air beside us to get her attention.  Grace under pressure is an underrated talent, and the full staff there should be commended for that talent.

Great ambiance and level of noise is low enough to hold conversation. Menu had a lot of delicious looking options. My friend had the tuna ceviche and cioppino, while I had the butternut squash risotto as an appetizer and the salmon. I tried my friend's tuna ceviche, and it was a well-curated combination of ingredients, but the dish was overall on the salty side and the seasoning felt uninspired. The texture of the risotto was a little mushy for my tastes, but again, the combination of ingredients and flavors were delicious. My salmon was perfectly cooked, soft and flaky on the inside with a crispy skin, and I loved the addition of brussel sprouts and persimmons to the sauce. One complaint would be that the hostesses were chatting to each other when we came in and ignored us for quite some time before acknowledging us and came off as rather pretentious. Waitstaff were very courteous and attentive.

Service was a little slow the night we visited but good food. Nice atmosphere and staff. Staff fairly attentive. Hostess with short dark hair elegant and seated us efficiently! (Emily, Natalie?) couldn't take our eyes off her! We will be back soon!
Very nice! Good food, and very helpful staff. They always attend to your needs as a customer, and generally have a nice welcoming attitude.

As always terrific food and highly attentive service. My fourth visit and all expectations continue to be met. But I'd like to mention the exceptionally high level of professionalism of the staff. They handled a difficult situation with a large, rowdy group that was disrupting the dining experience of others with grace. They quickly acknowledged the distribution, tried to quiet the group (who were truly loud and foul-mouthed) and then moved us to a different room. It was a Saturday night so I'm sure they were completely booked but they did not put up any resistance to the requests from several different tables to be moved away from the obnoxious, selfish, inconsiderate group.  It was not Mulherin's fault the group was loud and offensive- they were certainly place in a difficult position - but I really appreciate how they handled it.

I went here for lunch on Sunday with my niece to catch up and have some lunch.  She's local, but neither of us had been here and we were excited to check it out.  The place was pretty packed, so we took two seats at the window.

First came our chips and salsa.  The green salsa had more kick than expected, a definite pleasant surprise.  The red sauce had a nice smoky flavor and also was kinda spicy.  I ordered three al pastor tacos and a jamaica tea, while my niece got a torta (sorry, don't remember which kind) and a horchata.  Our food came a little while before the beverages.  The tacos were delicious and came with two lime wedges.  Super good, I wish I had asked to custom order a variety though.  My niece loved her sandwich.  My drink didn't come until I was almost done with my food, and it came about 10 minutes after my niece got her drink.  The wait staff was friendly when they came around, but they weren't super attentive.

Definitely enjoyed my meal, but the service was so-so.  I know it was busy that day but it put me off a little.  Check it out!  The food was fantastic!

My boyfriend and I were visiting Philly for the weekend and went for dinner after reading the other great reviews. I have to start by saying that both the food and service were out of this world. We did the "leave it to us" option where the chef decides what to send out. Aside from the food being unbelievably delicious and unique, there was SO much food included in this option. Between the small plates, appetizers, pasta, entrees, and desserts, there were probably 12 dishes between the two of us and each one was better than the last. The gnocchi with pesto and corn was one of the most delicious things I've ever eaten. I was practically yelling to the entire restaurant about how fabulous it was. The Parker House rolls were also unforgettable. Every dish was flavorful and stood out in its own way. You can read the menu but the descriptions don't do it justice. Also, the staff was so attentive and friendly, they truly elevated the whole experience. I can't say enough good things, we left so full and satisfied and just HAPPY about the whole evening.

We live nearby and eat here often. Always great food. Lovely style and vibe. Last Friday, however, we had poor service: we waited a lot, dirty dishes stayed around, water glasses empty, etc. The waiter's effusiveness doesn't substitute for paying attention to customers.

The food wasn't amazing. Perhaps my expectation was way too high given so many good reviews by people I found to be trustworthy. The food is about 3.5 stars and the service is about 4.5 stars. The portions are pretty big (for a fancy restaurant), so you won't have a problem filling yourself up. Seared foie gras was delicious; the daikon garnish was expertly diced. But the veal chop was somewhat disappointing. It just wasn't that interesting. My wife's fish entree with thai pepper sauce (which the waiter incorrectly called consume) was pretty good. However, her soup was just okay; the lavender flavor was a bit too overwhemling. The dessert (cherry and chocolate) that had liquid-nitro cooled cherry mouse sounded interesting but the execution looked messy.

I came here, expecting to be blown away. What we got instead was a not-so-amazing-but-decent meal with attentive, professional, friendly staff.

Great food, great service! I chowed down on the Shack Stack, their beef burger patty topped with their shroom burger patty (a fried portobello mushroom exploding with muenster and cheddar cheese). It was also topped off with fresh lettuce and tomato and ShackSauce. Despite the fact that they're probably going to serve hundreds of burgers in the first hours of being open, my burger was a perfect medium. Say goodbye to ordering burgers at restaurants, just go to Shake Shack! I decided to forgo fries and got a "Concrete" instead (think DQ Blizzard). I got the Liberty Shell concrete, which was Vanilla custard packed with delicious cannoli shell pieces and some strawberry stuff. 

The wait was around 40 minutes, start to finish, at opening time on opening day. It still felt like fast service given the swarms of people in line ahead of us. The staff was incredibly friendly, talking to everyone in line, giving out freebies and samples, and helping wherever help was needed. This was probably the best opening of any take out restaurant I've ever witnessed. Well done!

Must try: Tuna Pizza, Lobster Spring Rolls, General Tso Dumplings, Edamame Dumplings, and Lobster Fried Rice!

Why: Unique flavors and dishes! I loved everything we ordered. Tuna Pizza and Lobster Spring Rolls were our appetizers. My friend who doesn't eat raw fish actually loved the Tuna Pizza. There were actually large pieces of lobster in the spring rolls. General Tao Dumplings were tasty and not steaming hot where you burn your mouth. The Edamame Dumplings were actually served cold, which was surprising but they were delicious. The Lobster Fried Rice was also great and was my last bite to end dinner. 

Notes: Pricey, yes! However, this modern Asian cuisine was quite an experience. We came at 7:30pm on a Wednesday night and were seated right away without a reservation. You walk in the dim lit restaurant and immediately see a huge golden buddha statue. The service was incredible from the hostess to the waiter. They were very attentive.

I don't know where to begin!  The service at this restaurant is horrendous.  We waited 30 minutes to get beverages.  Our water glasses were rarely filled.  The food took an hour or more  to arrive.  Our waitress never cleared the table.  One person in our party got up to help clear the table of a few dishes.  We had to use cell phone flashlights to read the menu since the bulbs above us were out and it was dark.  Thank goodness the lights at City Hall in Philadelphia which were bright and shining through the windows, it was a big help.  Sam the hostess was terrible and non accommodating.  Our party leader's spouse fell ill and she was running late. She called Sam to inform him and when we arrived, all he could say is that the table was given away.  All he could offer was seating in the bar. Sam could have been more helpful.  The manager was worse.  We asked for two extra chairs to accommodate the party, and she appeared inconvenienced to give chairs for her diners.  The bathroom needed attention.   We paid almost $700 for the meal for the party.  M&S's owner should be ashamed to give people such poor service!  Beware of this place, go elsewhere!

Total ripoff...

Let me get this straight.  The standard burger with lettuce and tomato -- no cheese, no fries -- is $11. You want cheese, that's another $3.50. You want fries, pony up another $5 (which, BTW, are carefully propped up in a thin metal can to disguise just how small an order it is). So for a standard cheeseburger and fries, you're looking at close to $20. Don't even think about adding on bacon and onions, because that another $4, which now pushes the total closer to $25.  Seriously???

Finally, that $6 you're paying for a draught beer.  Surprise!  Unlike most bars / restaurants where you're expecting a pint for your six bucks, here it's a 12 ouncer.

Yes, this is a nice bar with high quality pub fare. But by no means is it a four or five star restaurant. This place is all about squeezing every last penny from the customer.

Never again. Never.

P.S.  Not to pile on, but I also had to comment about the poor service: slow, confused and unfriendly.

Total miss,pass this one by! Staff was inattentive and disinterested. Their conversation amongst each other was more important than helping customers. Rude and uncaring. Bacon was burnt,toast was burnt,eggs were not how I ordered them. Robots could do a better job than these unhappy people. Then they kicked me out from the seating area because I ordered from the take away counter...wtf I just want to eat my 10 min of breakfast then catch my damn flight.

A restaurant is only as good as the service they offer. I went in on a Wednesday night around 9:30pm for dinner and waited about 10 minutes before someone came over to my table. Luckily, another waitress saw me sitting their waiting and came over and got me a glass of wine and some bread. I ended up ordering dinner from that same waitress because my waiter was still "busy". I finally met my waiter when my food was brought out. He never came to the table to ask how the food was and it took another 10 minutes to flag him down for the check. The food was good, but I'll never return to this location again due to the poor service.
Poor service. The waiter would not even answer you when there were only 3 customers in the restaurant. waited 20 minutes for the check.

Expect poor service.  Each time I've been here something has gone wrong and it's all because of the lackluster effort of the staff.  This morning, the woman working the registered mumbled something at me when I stepped up and when I said "sorry, didn't catch that" she simply rolled her hand at me in a "just order" kind of way.  There was no line, the phone wasn't ringing, there were other staff working... she clearly wasn't slammed - or even busy - no excuse to be rude.  So whatever, I placed my order and waited.  And waited.  And waited.  Until I eventually asked about my order - which had been placed aside as a call-in order.  No apology for having me wait 20 minutes, no indication what-so-ever that a mistake was made, not even a mumble this time... just an uncaring hand extending what turned out to be a now cold breakfast sandwich.  This review won't matter because everyone experiences this here and they've just come to expect it.  It's the only place around and there are a lot of hungry and thirsty people on the way to work.  It's sad though, because being nice isn't hard and that's really the only thing this place needs.

Awful service. The food is great, but I had a horrible experience with customer service. I have been to this restaurant multiple times and enjoyed the food, but when I ordered take out it took more than 2 hours for our food to show up. When we called to check on the order after an hour, they told us the food was on its way. However, it still did not arrive an hour later. When we asked to speak with a manager, the manager was rude and non-apologetic about their mistake. It took them more than 15 minutes on the phone to finally apologize for the mistake. It's a shame when a restaurant with such great food has such poor service.

Rude and snarky staff from hostess to wait staff. Unaccomidating.

Food- rushed, assembly line, in-and out atmosphere.

Not worth the poor service.

This is probably one of the best places in the neighborhood. It has friendly staff and pretty good food. In fact, I don't think I've had anything I didn't like. (Except the coconut shrimp which clearly were not cleaned before cooking - ick!)  Unfortunately, the service sucks. 

The first few times I went here the service was average - I didn't have to wait exceptionally long for anything. Lately, it seems like the staff just forgets they have people in the dining room. I might understand if the restaurant were full but it never is. So why do I have 10 minutes for someone to come greet me after I've been seated, another 5 for some water, and another 5 to order food? And this is on a regular basis! At least seat me with the menu to speed up the process.

Incredibly rude staff. I know it's a fast food burger joint and I'm not walking in expecting to be treated like I'm at a Steven Starr restaurant, but these people treat you terribly. A little kindness and respect goes a long long way in this world.

TERRIBLE service.  Came in and sat down at the bar, right in front of the kitchen doors.  There was TONS of staff, standing behind the counter there, walking in and out of the kitchen.  I was there a WHILE with menus in hand.  Nobody even looked at me let alone greeted me.  Left hungry and annoyed.  How hard would "hi" be?  Wont be returning.  Pretentious and tbh I dont love their beer anyway.

This place is #1 in both terrible service and utter rudeness. Our goal was simply to order food at the host station and take it to go. The entire process, 1/2 of which was time spent trying to get someone to recognize us, took 50 minutes. The restaurant was not busy (only 5 tables occupied) and it appeared at times as though the staff was intentionally trying to ignore us and most of the other customers that were waiting. The Asian customers were getting attention and being treated with respect while all but one of our group and others waiting at the host station were black. It felt racial, especially when the arrogant employee finally took our order. He had an attitude and clearly didn't want to help us. He reluctantly took our order and after another ~25" we were on our way. Not cool.

Arrived with my party of 6 and the service was the worse! They really need to get better management and not have patrons waiting so long to get a waiter to serve them. We were seated after a 15-minute wait, to just sit even longer waiting to have a server acknowledge us. By this point, my table was upset waiting so long especially since we had a 2-year-old with us who is antsy and cannot wait very long. 

This is the first time in 6 months that I have been back to this restaurant because I had a terrible time at my last visit. The last visit the customer service was trash, the wait was horribly long and the food wasnt as I remeber it tasting. The last visit the waitress was rude and bitchy. Here I am again invited by a family member who was treating, and I was hoping this would be a better experience then the last. But nope! the wait was soo long, and we were getting angry as the waitstaff walked passed and didnt stop and help us for a long time. 

Once we finally got a server, we ordered right away since we had to wait so long just to get a server to come and help us. So we placed our order, and we literally waited 45 minutes to receive our meals. This service here is a joke! I dont even think a manager was on duty at this shit show. I understand you are busy, but they always seem to be and should prepare on how they will assist each table in a timely manner. 

When the food finally came out it was tasty, but waiting for refills was terribly long, asking for napkins, sauces for our nuggets came way later after we had already eaten most of our meals. 

The food is always on point, but I cant get past the terrible service, so I wont be back here again.

Stopped by for a cup of tea and a bite to eat after a LONG day, hoping for a relaxing experience.  Was sadly disappointed.  The server was sullen and unfriendly.  She never once smiled, and her expression was basically, "I'm doing you a favor."  After the food was ready, she just left it on the counter for the customers to find on their own, even though it's a small place, and it would have been easy for her to bring the food over or at least let you know that your food is ready.  I enjoyed my wrap, but the experience was unpleasant, and I won't be coming back due to the poor service.
Very rude staff. Manager did not want to make Good on waiter mistake. Food was over cooked and after waiter was rude the manager did not fix problem

The food here is good, but the service is awful. Servers and bartenders are completely inattentive and the food consistently takes far too long to long to come out.  

I live a block away and have been here many times, always hoping for a better experience. But it's always the same story: the bartenders much prefer to stand and talk to the off-shift employees drinking rather than take care of paying customers. 

Train your staffer better or you'll lose more customers. You've lost me -- I won't be back.

I came here with a few of my friends who never had Korean Bbq before and I'm very disappointed with the customer service. When you come to a new place unfamiliar with the food you are bound to ask questions. When my friends and i were asking the waitress questions she was very rude about answering them; she was very frustrated about us asking her questions about items on the menu. The food was good and if the customer service was amazing I'm sure the food would have tasted better. Unfortunately since the customer service was terrible the whole experience was not worth the money. At the end of the meal we were given the check by the manager (i believe) and he was also rude about us giving them a tip. Let's just say we gave them a decent tip even tho the customer service was just terrible and once we were leaving the restaurant all the employees just stared us down in spite. Not coming here ever again!

My family and I went to this restaurant tonight and it was disappointing. The food was not good. I could deal with that. The real issue was the poor service - it was slow and unprofessional. My mom asked the waitress for bread and the waitress threw up her hands and sighed loudly  at my mom (it was Mother's Day too). I am sure the waitress was overwhelmed by the large crowds, but that is not an excuse to be rude to a customer. I am really disappointed and I will not be returning.

drafts必须恰好有4项，且必须是2项positive和2项negative。
